title: Yoga, Pilates & Mind-Body Hour-of-Day Activity Heatmap
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mat:usage
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day most yoga, pilates events typically arrive.
value: Hour-of-day patterns expose automation schedules, commute windows, and habits that are easy to miss in daily totals alone.
implementation: Ingest `mat:usage` with accurate `_time` values and chart hourly counts to see when the feed is naturally busy or quiet.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of event count by hour of day.
grandmaExplanation: It notices what time of day your yoga, pilates data is usually busiest so you can spot routines that moved or feeds that went quiet at the wrong hour.
